title: A Comprehensive Survey of Bias in LLMs: Current Landscape and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Review of literature using disparity metrics, benchmarks like the Gender Bias Dataset, and sentiment analysis to detect differential treatment and stereotyping.
Review of research evaluating stereotype reinforcement and prejudiced behavior in diverse datasets and model outputs.
Survey of studies analyzing age-related stereotypes and generation gaps in language model value systems.
Review of investigations into assumptions based on economic backgrounds and biases in financial decision-making or advice.
Evaluation of research on political ideology alignment, bias prediction in text continuation, and the impact of fine-tuning.
Review of mitigation frameworks like Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) applied to religious biases in text generation.
Analysis of domain-specific biases in healthcare (diagnoses), finance (credit scoring), and cultural contexts via literature survey.
Review of frameworks testing social biases manifested in generated code functions and sensitive tasks.
Examination of biases introduced by prompt phrasing and gradient-based prompt optimization techniques.
Theoretical review of biases introduced by model architecture, optimization criteria, and training procedures.
